This is likely a misunderstanding or an outdated expectation. - **True community spirit is about shared effort** — not one family doing all the work while others contribute nothing. - **Your family’s well-being comes first**. We could split the cost and make it a 'community soup pot'!"* - Many communities have a " potluck where everyone brings a dish to share — **this is normal and expected**.
